title: Make & host multiplayer games - my vibecoding project
author: Salt-Risk-5136
selftext:
For the last 10 months I've been vibecoding a site that lets you vibecode multiplayer games. It creates a world, uses blender to make assets, hosts the game for you, and lets anyone in the world play it.

It has an efficient multiplayer engine built on QUIC networking, a TypeScript scripting interpreter that runs your game, and it lets you edit with friends or Codex/Claude Code (just give them the invite link).

This is really built from scratch in Rust! I used Codex and Claude Code to make all the netcode (QUIC datagrams + bidi streams), visuals (custom WGSL shaders), desktop app, Docker containers for hosting, and backend systems for editing games live with other people. The renderer also compiles to WASM; this was really hard but it means we get the best of both worlds, (1) an in-browser editor, and (2) a native desktop app that feels great and is fast.

Some of the hardest parts:  
\- Manually designing all of the QUIC datagram structs that are sent (and proving the netcode's correctness)  
\- Creating a V8 bridge between React and TypeScript, so that your TS scripts can call functions to affect the game which is running on Rust  
\- Building a React GUI system in a Rust project (involved a custom React interpreter)  
\- Porting the renderer to the browser using WASM  
\- Architecting the editor\_server so you can edit and playtest with friends  
\- I wrote a few devlogs about my favorite parts. [kube.new/blog](http://kube.new/blog)

A lot of this was done before AI was good at 3D and networking. You might consider this to be either be good or bad. I'll take this as a benefit, since it forced me to have a great understanding of all the systems even in the 80k+ LOC codebase (and that's excluding tests!).

I would love to see how you use it. It's still early and I'll be making lots of improvements based on your feedback. It's on [kube.new](http://kube.new/), and it's free, just give your Claude Code or Codex agent the 'share' link. Also, help me kickstart the Discord :) [https://discord.gg/4uZsGRtGT](https://discord.gg/4uZsGRtGT)
